regulatory_information.special_operating_instructions: Open Recon SynthSeg brain segmentation pipeline

information.en: Define the config to be executed by MRD server
Return restamped original images first, before the SynthSeg label map.

Trained network used for segmentation. SynthSeg 2.0 is the default. SynthSeg-robust is slower but more reliable on low-quality clinical scans and always runs in fast mode. SynthSeg 1.0 is the original 2021 model, kept for reproducing older results.
Also run the cortical parcellation network so the label map contains the 2000/2035-series Desikan-Killiany cortical parcels. Adds roughly one further inference pass.
Bypass topological refinement and left/right flipping for a faster prediction. Recommended for inline scanner use; disable for the highest-quality offline-equivalent result.
Run inference on the reconstruction GPU. CPU inference is the default to avoid GPU memory exhaustion; enable this only when enough GPU memory is available.

Use -1 to disable cropping, 0 to crop automatically to the non-zero bounding box, or a positive voxel size to crop every RAS axis. Positive values are rounded up to a multiple of 32. A crop that is too small may exclude anatomy.
Number of TensorFlow inter/intra-op threads. Only relevant for the CPU parts of the pipeline.
Compute per-structure volumes in mm3 and write them to the reconstruction log as CSV.
Run the automated quality-control network and write per-structure QC scores to the reconstruction log as CSV.

Send the label map in a source-geometry 2D segmentation-header format so scanner post-processing treats it as a segmentation stream. When disabled, the label map keeps the source image header identity and post-processing stays on the original stream.
Send an additional sagittal 3D reformat of the label map.
Send an additional coronal 3D reformat of the label map.
Skip SynthSeg inference and create a simple threshold-based segmentation for send-path debugging.
